scenario_title: Dropped index, sequential scans at peak
title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-07-19 22:41-01:31: api-gateway: 182 of 241 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-19 22:41 and 2026-07-20 01:31 UTC (peak error ratio 0.9 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 28.716 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} dropped index ix_jobs_state on meta-db.jobs (it looked unused on the replica); the hot query fell back to sequential scans and timed out at peak.
_templates.remediation: Recreate ix_jobs_state CONCURRENTLY on meta-db; roll back {svc} if needed; check index usage on the primary before dropping.

culprit.diff:
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@ migration
 -- index cleanup (storage cost)
+DROP INDEX IF EXISTS ix_jobs_state;  -- unused according to pg_stat_user_indexes (replica only)
 COMMIT;

rca.macro: Deploy v2.28.0 of compute-svc dropped index ix_jobs_state on meta-db.jobs (it looked unused on the replica); the hot query fell back to sequential scans and timed out at peak.
rca.remediation: Recreate ix_jobs_state CONCURRENTLY on meta-db; roll back compute-svc if needed; check index usage on the primary before dropping.

action_items: Add a regression test covering migration (compute/db/migrations/V90__cleanup_indexes.sql).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
